description: NIST's FTC-07 whole. It reads: edge #1963 fitted past the cap (real/pcurve-fit-reported-as-gap), and the pcurves of its B-spline faces, once 6e-7 past their knot domain, held inside it. The checker at Full then left S5 undecided for the fillet torus f30 (and f32) against the plane f197, tilted 2° and tangent to the torus's rim on its seam: the tracer's seam root landed 6.8e-7 from the tangency, outside its cell, and was refused as UnresolvedTurning. It is the tangency, one touch (ADR-0026's amendment of step 5)
